description: 1.20.4 to 1.20.5. Item NBT was replaced by data components, and the loader ecosystem split: Forge kept META-INF/mods.toml while NeoForge moved to neoforge.mods.toml. The class layout barely moved, so this pack is small on purpose — most of what breaks here is behavioural, not nominal, and Octo does not pretend otherwise.

removed.name: getTag
removed.note: item NBT became data components in 1.20.5; there is no faithful equivalent, so reads return null rather than silently returning the wrong thing

removed.name: getOrCreateTag
removed.note: as getTag; writes through the old API cannot be represented as components
